{{Current events|year=2022|month=02|day=8|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***[[Israel]] says that the [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian military]] fired an [[anti-aircraft warfare|anti-aircraft missile]] towards its territory, which [[explode]]d in mid-air over the north of the country, triggering [[Civil defense siren|air raid sirens]]. However, Syrian [[Syrian Arab News Agency|state television]] reports that an [[Israeli Air Force]] airstrike occurred near [[Damascus]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/rocket-warning-sirens-sound-northern-israel-military-says-2022-02-08/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] says it has struck several [[Syrian Air Defense Force|Syrian air defense]] batteries and radars in response to the missile entering Israeli [[airspace]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/rocket-warning-sirens-sound-near-umm-al-fahm-northern-west-bank/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Five rangers and a soldier are killed and 10 others injured during an [[ambush]] by unidentified assailants at the W National Park, in [[Benin]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/10/five-rangers-one-soldier-killed-in-benin-park-ambush (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Shin Bet]] officers kill three [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades]] [[militant]]s in the [[West Bank]] after opening fire on their vehicle. Israel says that the men were armed and were responsible for a series of [[drive-by shooting]]s in recent weeks. Protests occur in the West Bank in response to the killings. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-forces-kill-three-palestinian-gunmen-israeli-security-service-says-2022-02-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|Islamic State insurgency in Iraq]]
**An [[Iraq]]i [[airstrike]] kills seven [[Islamic State]] members in [[Hatra District]], [[Nineveh Governorate]]. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/others/7-is-terrorists-killed-by-airstrike-in-iraq20220209000227/ (ANI)]
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**In an operation against the [[PKK]], the [[Turkish Air Force]] bombards a city in [[Erbil District]]. No known casualties are recorded. [https://www.rudaw.net/english/kurdistan/08022022 (Rudaw)]
*[[Mali War]]
**A joint [[military operation|operation]] by the [[Malian Armed Forces]] and the French-led [[Takuba Task Force]] kills at least 30 [[jihadism|jihadists]]. A [[Dassault Mirage 2000|Mirage 2000]] [[fighter jet]] was involved in the operation, bombing a group of [[militant]]s on motorbikes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-30-islamist-militants-killed-mali-joint-operations-france-says-2022-02-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Felix Tshisekedi]] and his office report an attempted [[coup d'etat]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/congo-warns-security-threat-amid-coup-plot-reports-82755758 (ABC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*A planned [[United States dollar|US$]]66 billion merger between British [[semiconductor]] company [[Arm Ltd.]] and American [[Computer hardware|hardware]] company [[Nvidia]] is cancelled after facing regulatory pressures from the [[United States]], the [[European Union]], the [[United Kingdom]], and [[China]]. Arm says that it will instead [[Initial public offering|go public]] sometime before March 2023. If the deal were successful, it would have been the largest merger in the history of the semiconductor industry. [https://www.reuters.com/business/softbanks-66-bln-sale-arm-nvidia-collapses-ft-2022-02-08/ (Reuters)] [https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2022/02/nvidia-abandons-66-billion-arm-purchase/ (''Ars Technica'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Colombia landslides]]
**[[Landslide]]s kill at least 14 people and injure 35 in [[Dosquebradas]], [[Risaralda Department]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-60152012 (BBC News)]  [https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-mudslide-kills-at-least-14/a-60706996 (DW News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 625 new [[COVID-19]] cases, prompting the [[Government of Hong Kong|government]] to impose strict [[social distancing]] measures in [[places of worship]] and hair salons as well as limiting private gatherings to two people beginning on February 10. [https://english.alarabiya.net/coronavirus/2022/02/08/Hong-Kong-imposes-its-strictest-social-distancing-rules-to-date-as-COVID-cases-soar (Al-Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 159 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://jen.jiji.com/jc/eng?g=eco&k=2022020801180 (Jiji Press)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
***[[Poland]] indefinitely postpones its deadline of March 1 for mandatory full [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccination]] of teachers, members of the [[Polish Land Forces|army]] and police officers, due to the current [[vaccination]] rate. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-health-europe-poland-504bf4c73cce829eb4f1a2985bd3d026 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Slovakia–United States relations]]
**Thousands of [[Slovaks]] protest in [[Bratislava]] against a potential military defense treaty between [[Slovakia]] and the [[United States]]. Police prevented some protesters from entering the [[National Council (Slovakia)|National Council]] building, where the bill is being debated by lawmakers. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/slovaks-protest-defense-treaty-us-lawmakers-debate-82753596 (ABC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Mars sample-return mission]]
**[[NASA]] awards [[Lockheed Martin]] a contract to build a next-generation "Mars Ascent Vehicle" to return the first rock samples from [[Mars]] to [[Earth]] in the 2030s. [https://phys.org/news/2022-02-lockheed-martin-nasa-mars-samples.html (Phys)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Winter Olympics]]
**[[Italy at the 2022 Winter Olympics]]
***Unexpectedly undefeated in all 11 competitions at the [[Curling at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Mixed doubles tournament|Olympic curling mixed doubles tournament]], Italy wins the first historic gold medal: the [[curling broom]] used in the final has been donated to the [[Olympic Museum]]. [https://www.eurosport.com/curling/beijing-2022/2022/winter-olympics-2022-flawless-italy-remain-unbeaten-to-win-curling-gold-in-mixed-doubles-as-norway-s_sto8768815/story.shtml (Eurosport)]
